El Niño could strain India's power system, widen coal dependence: CREA

A report by the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA) suggests that the El Niño weather phenomenon could significantly impact India's energy system. The report indicates that India's power system may be strained more than other regions globally due to El Niño. This could potentially lead to increased reliance on coal for power generation.
